verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ הַֽלְלוּ־ אֵ֥ל בְּקָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בִּרְקִ֥יעַ עֻזּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū yāh hal·lū- ’êl bə·qā·ḏə·šōw hal·lū·hū bir·qî·a‘ ‘uz·zōw
verses.literal: Hallelujah . . . Praise God in His sanctuary Praise Him in His mighty heavens
verses.literalPt: Louvai a Jeová! Louvai a Deus no seu santuário; louvai-o no firmamento, obra do seu poder.

verses.literal: Praise Him for His mighty acts praise Him for His excellent greatness
verses.literalPt: Louvai-o pelos seus poderosos atos, louvai-o conforme a abundância da sua grandeza.

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְּתֵ֣קַע שׁוֹפָ֑ר הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּנֵ֣בֶל וְכִנּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū·hū bə·ṯê·qa‘ šō·w·p̄ār hal·lū·hū bə·nê·ḇel wə·ḵin·nō·wr
verses.literal: Praise Him with the sound of the horn praise Him with the harp and lyre
verses.literalPt: Louvai-o ao som da trombeta, louvai-o com saltério e com harpa.

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְתֹ֣ף וּמָח֑וֹל הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּמִנִּ֥ים וְעוּגָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū·hū ḇə·ṯōp̄ ū·mā·ḥō·wl hal·lū·hū bə·min·nîm wə·‘ū·ḡāḇ
verses.literal: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing praise Him with strings and flute
verses.literalPt: Louvai-o com adufe e com dança, louvai-o com instrumentos de cordas e com flautas.

verses.original: הַֽלְל֥וּהוּ בְצִלְצְלֵי־ שָׁ֑מַע הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּֽצִלְצְלֵ֥י תְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū·hū ḇə·ṣil·ṣə·lê- šā·ma‘ hal·lū·hū bə·ṣil·ṣə·lê ṯə·rū·‘āh
verses.literal: Praise Him with clashing cymbals praise Him with resounding cymbals
verses.literalPt: Louvai-o com sonoros címbalos, louvai-o com címbalos retumbantes.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל הַ֭נְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּ֥ל יָ֗הּ הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōl han·nə·šā·māh tə·hal·lêl yāh hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD Hallelujah . . .
verses.literalPt: Todo ser que respira louve a Jeová. Louvai a Jeová!
